integration_note: This is an authoring reference, not a runtime import payload. New scenes and literary particulars require deliberate adaptation. The game repository has not been modified.

chapters.label: Prologue
chapters.title: The Painted Crow
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Introduce the missing travelers before Kael arrives.

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: A Hunter's Price
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Establish ordinary paid work, Greyfen's routines and Kael's intended departure. Cart assistance makes his first relationship concrete.

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: The Broken Cart
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Recover bounded physical clues through Wychwood combat. Wire suggests intervention without establishing who caused the attack.

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: What We Brought Back
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Make the reporting choice, custody and Kael's decision to stay playable rather than automatic.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: A Widow's Bell
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Connect cemetery investigation to Elna's marriage and Harl's incomplete account.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: The Rope
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Prepared Bell-Eater encounter; Anwen's novice account; temporary chapel containment.

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The One Who Returned
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Nera recognizes Kael during relief work. Bracken remains a dependent animal, without granting forgiveness.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: Under Green Water
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Toma's protection secret, Pell's treatment and Mira's disclosure precede the bog.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: The Name in the Reeds
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Oren's bounded fragment, private return and actual burial. Preserve the distinction between body, object and memory.

chapters.label: Chapter 9
chapters.title: No Footsteps Back
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Nera's present survey challenges Kael's account. The novel's additional footbridge is proposed geography.

chapters.label: Chapter 10
chapters.title: The Names They Burned
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Recover partial registers; earn passage through the Colossus encounter; establish Anwen's full present concealment chain.

chapters.label: Chapter 11
chapters.title: The Widow's Version
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Separate institutional disclosure from Elna's private marriage memories and family addresses.

chapters.label: Chapter 12
chapters.title: What We Carried
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Physically recover the medicine load after consulting Nera, Mira and Tor.

chapters.label: Chapter 13
chapters.title: Ash at the Mill
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Ashwing, worker rescue and attributed accounts connect inherited harm to present livelihoods.

chapters.label: Chapter 14
chapters.title: Iron Remembers
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Supervised milling, replacement work and Tor's proposed lasting wrist injury.

chapters.label: Chapter 15
chapters.title: Bread and Ash
chapters.anchor_context: main_ash_at_the_mill aftermath; existing Mira relationship scenes
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Rest, intimacy and the renewal threat. No new compulsory romance quest.

chapters.label: Chapter 16
chapters.title: The Empty Tables
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Prepare the common kitchen. Rook's route-sharing betrayal is a proposed parallel scene.

chapters.label: Chapter 17
chapters.title: A Place at the Table
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Complete service and accounts; Rook admits the disclosure before the later interception.

chapters.label: Chapter 18
chapters.title: A Road Kept Open
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Choose the ferry, prepare both banks, accompany and unload a real first load.

chapters.label: Chapter 19
chapters.title: A Soldier Without a Banner
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Earn Senn's stand-down through a dangerous, spatially clear encounter.

chapters.label: Chapter 20
chapters.title: The Officer's Hand
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Custody, restitution inventory and separately voluntary testimony.

chapters.label: Chapter 21
chapters.title: Hold the Rear
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Protect the rear under Nera's direction. The patrol interception and Rook's injury expand the existing crossing.

chapters.label: Chapter 22
chapters.title: The Man Who Keeps Keys
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Archive access, Merrow's choices and detained workers. Introduce the proposed Refusal Book.

chapters.label: Chapter 23
chapters.title: Blood Under Stone
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Distinguish the old command from Edric's later suppression. Copy and preserve primary proof.

chapters.label: Chapter 24
chapters.title: The Price of Bread
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Expose current coercion; refuse a settlement preserving household assent.

chapters.label: Chapter 25
chapters.title: The Last Witness
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Halvern's bounded hearing and release in the undercroft, after an earned defensive encounter.

chapters.label: Chapter 26
chapters.title: The Word Retreat
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Kael corrects his separate report. The novel relocates the conversation and marks remembered wording as reconstruction.

chapters.label: Chapter 27
chapters.title: The House That Was Empty
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Survey Hearthward and establish only basic first-night shelter.

chapters.label: Chapter 28
chapters.title: The House of Many Names
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Complete beds, care space and dry records; welcome actual first arrivals.

chapters.label: Chapter 29
chapters.title: What Remains Private
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Protect intimate material; confront Kael without treating love as acquittal.

chapters.label: Chapter 30
chapters.title: What We Promise
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Test meals, alarm and handover; record individual answers; complete the first watch.

chapters.label: Chapter 31
chapters.title: The Refusal Book
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Secure a current grain-refusal duplicate. It supplements guaranteed main proof.

chapters.label: Chapter 32
chapters.title: Crowns Without Mercy
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Remove the ration condition before witnesses speak. A supply-office side quest cannot substitute for Assembly completion.

chapters.label: Chapter 33
chapters.title: The Hart Remembers
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Hear the complete old account; weigh actual alternatives; select a method without instantly completing it.

chapters.label: Chapter 34
chapters.title: The Last Load
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Dismantle the territorial ward, lose Hart access and begin physical migration.

chapters.label: Chapter 35
chapters.title: The Man Who Came Back
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Rescue and deliver both dependent households. Flood failure and calf injury are proposed additions.

chapters.label: Chapter 36
chapters.title: The Relief Handover
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Reconcile actual goods and routes; offer company without claiming reconciliation.

chapters.label: Epilogue
chapters.title: The Road Between Crowns
chapters.adaptation_purpose: Show the selected route six months after the final migration.
